Class PlayerTurnPhase

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.model.game.StatePhases.PlayerTurnPhase
All Implemented Interfaces:
GamePhaseBehavior, Serializable
public class PlayerTurnPhase extends Object implements GamePhaseBehavior
PLAYER_TURN phase behavior. Handles the full turn logic for the player occupying the current tile:
  1. Identifies the player on the current tile
  2. Triggers all buildings with triggerKey == PLAYER_TURN
  3. The player performs picks (upper/bottom) as defined by the tile
  4. Advances the tile index and transitions back to TURN

    • triggerOnCardPick

      private void triggerOnCardPick(Player player, GameState context)
      Triggers ON_CARD_PICK buildings for the active player only. This fires per-pick, not globally, so we avoid publishTrigger which would iterate all active players.

    • handlePlayerDisconnect

      public boolean handlePlayerDisconnect(GameState context, Player player)
      Skips the active player's turn when they disconnect.

      Only acts when the leaver is the player this phase is bound to; a different player disconnecting does not affect the current drafter. Returning to TurnPhase resumes the tile scan from currentTileIndex, which TurnPhase already advanced past this player's tile before entering the PlayerTurnPhase, so their turn is cleanly skipped.

      Specified by:
      handlePlayerDisconnect in interface GamePhaseBehavior
      Parameters:
      context - the game state
      player - the player who just disconnected
      Returns:
      true if the turn was skipped, false otherwise
